name: HCT Tonal
description: Generated from one seed color as HCT tonal palettes: every anchor is a tone of the seed's hue or a hue 60 degrees on.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform. HCT is the color space Google's Material Design defines, credited here: this isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Google, and it doesn't claim Material's own tones.
provenance.derivation: Generated by @portfolio/appearance/generators hct-tonal, version 1: hct@1 takes each anchor as a tone of the seed's HCT palettes, and anchor-v2 solves the rest. HCT is CAM16 hue and chroma (Li et al., 2017) with CIELAB L* as tone, computed first-party from the published formulas.

fallbacks: High contrast renders the high-contrast sets the generator solves with high-contrast-v2, and print renders the light set.
caveats: Renders from the sets a draft save generates from the site's appearanceInputs entry and stores with the revision. Until a site has them, warm-parchment renders in its place.
